params.title: Component parameters
params.description: Parameters of the Collidable component class - 'x_tiles', 'y_tiles', 'dx_tiles', 'dy_tiles' (preferred) or 'x', 'y', 'dx', 'dy' (absolute pixels), plus 'allowlist', 'denylist', 'apply_pos_fix_to_allowlist', 'apply_pos_fix_to_denylist', 'accept_pos_fix_from_allowlist', 'accept_pos_fix_from_denylist', 'position_fix_walkaround_mode'.

x_tiles.title: X-axis (tiles)
x_tiles.description: X-axis collision zone +- from the centre, as a fraction of a tile. Scales with GAME.TILE_RES_PX. Preferred over 'x'.

y_tiles.title: Y-axis (tiles)
y_tiles.description: Y-axis collision zone +- from the centre, as a fraction of a tile. Scales with GAME.TILE_RES_PX. Preferred over 'y'.

dx_tiles.title: X-axis offset (tiles)
dx_tiles.description: Offset of the zone centre on the X-axis, as a fraction of a tile. Scales with GAME.TILE_RES_PX.

dy_tiles.title: Y-axis offset (tiles)
dy_tiles.description: Offset of the zone centre on the Y-axis, as a fraction of a tile. Scales with GAME.TILE_RES_PX.

x.title: X-axis (pixels)
x.description: X-axis collision zone in absolute pixels. Never scaled - prefer 'x_tiles' so the zone stays in proportion with the sprite.

dx.title: X-axis offset (pixels)
dx.description: Offset for X-axis collision zone in absolute pixels. Never scaled - prefer 'dx_tiles'.

y.title: Y-axis (pixels)
y.description: Y-axis collision zone in absolute pixels. Never scaled - prefer 'y_tiles' so the zone stays in proportion with the sprite.

dy.title: Y-axis offset (pixels)
dy.description: Offset for Y-axis collision zone in absolute pixels. Never scaled - prefer 'dy_tiles'.

allowlist.title: Collision Allowlist
allowlist.description: List of entities which can collide with entity. ['ALL'] for all entities.

denylist.title: Collision Denylist
denylist.description: List of entities which can not collide with entity. ['ALL'] for all entities.

apply_pos_fix_to_allowlist.title: Apply Collision Allowlist
apply_pos_fix_to_allowlist.description: Apply fixing of position of others only in this allowlist upon hitting this entity.

apply_pos_fix_to_denylist.title: Apply Collision Denylist
apply_pos_fix_to_denylist.description: Do not apply fixing of position of others only in this denylist upon hitting this entity.

accept_pos_fix_from_allowlist.title: Accept Collision Allowlist
accept_pos_fix_from_allowlist.description: Accept fixing of entity's position from entities in allowlist only.

accept_pos_fix_from_denylist.title: Accept Collision Denylist
accept_pos_fix_from_denylist.description: Do not accept fixing of entity's position from entities in denylist only.

position_fix_walkaround_mode.title: Walkaround Mode
position_fix_walkaround_mode.description: Should the entity walkaround the other entity upon collision
